Great speaking with you earlier — thanks for walking through your procurement and AP requirements. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can get you set up on the right commercial path: 

1) What we heard:
- Primary goal is production-ready inference for the customer data pipeline (expected pilot ~Q3).
- Procurement preference: appears to be PO-based for vendor onboarding and accounting; credit card only for ad-hoc / low-dollar transactions.
- Marketplace: you asked if Redwood is available via any marketplaces (this can simplify purchase orders).

2) What Redwood can do now:
- We can accept vendor POs and support Net30 terms for enterprise contracts.
- We have a standard vendor onboarding packet and an MSA that can be sent via DocuSign.
- If you prefer marketplace procurement, we can confirm marketplace availability and share a marketplace SKU/quote.

3) Asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm whether FinOpsCo requires an initial PO to kick off the pilot or whether a single one-time CC charge is acceptable for an initial evaluation?
- Please share (or confirm) the AP contact, billing address, and any vendor form requirements (W-9, insurance cert, vendor questionnaire).
- I will route our vendor onboarding form and DocuSign MSA to you and copy Lauren (ops) to speed vendor onboarding.

Planned next steps from our side: I’ll send the Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form and a DocuSign link to the MSA tomorrow. If you prefer marketplace, I’ll check our marketplace listing and follow up with a formal quote.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I have the packet ready.

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from AP/Procurement: 

- FinOpsCo prefers PO for any multi-month or subscription commitments. Credit card is allowable for one-off purchases under $5,000 but not for ongoing subscriptions.
- AP needs a completed W-9, certificate of insurance (general liability), and a vendor questionnaire (we typically send our questionnaire to prospective vendors).
- Net30 is our standard; we can do Net45 for new vendors on a case-by-case basis but prefer Net30.
- Marketplace: if Redwood is available on the CloudMarket marketplace with a managed listing, that would be ideal — it speeds approvals. Can you confirm marketplace presence and whether billing would be through the marketplace or Redwood directly?

Next steps for us: please send the vendor packet (W-9 + onboarding form) and a formal quote/SOW indicating list price and any discounts; AP will route once we have those docs. I’ve included Brian (procurement) to help track.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Senior Procurement Manager | FinOpsCo
